title: Carrier Mismatch Diagnosis
question: Shipment SHP-009 had a refrigeration failure. Was choosing Kerry Express a mistake given the product?

critical_facts: SHP-009 uses Kerry Express (CAR-001, ground type)
Associated order is ORD-011 with product PROD-003 (refrigerated)
This is a mismatch — ground carrier should not carry refrigerated product
important_facts: Refrigerated alternatives exist (SCG Cold Chain CAR-002 or Flash Express CAR-003)
Exception reason recorded: refrigeration unit malfunction on delivery vehicle
